study_archetype: computational fluid-structure interaction simulation of targeted microbubble adhesion in patient-specific AAA

reported_items.raw_name: Objective: investigate surface adhesion of drug-containing microbubbles to AAA inner wall
Study design: fluid-structure interaction (FSI) simulation using patient CT-scan geometry
Data/sample: single patient with 40-mm diameter abdominal aortic aneurysm (CT scan)
Methods: simulation of ligand-receptor binding-mediated adhesion of four microbubble types and three diameters
reported_items.sub_category: ligand-receptor adhesion modeling; MB types and diameters compared

reported_items.raw_name: Numerical/experimental setting (broad): variation of blood mechanical properties (hematocrit changes for anemia/diabetes) and artery inlet velocity
reported_items.sub_category: parameter variations: Hct and inlet velocity

reported_items.raw_name: Outcomes: effect of blood flow on microbubble delivery/adherence to intended surface
